text: Code reviews are an essential part of software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code goes into production. This saves time and money, as fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also encourage knowledge sharing within the team. Developers learn from each other's ideas and techniques, which helps everyone improve. In addition, regular reviews improve overall team quality, because everyone feels responsible for the final product. Although code reviews take extra time, they are worth the effort. They lead to cleaner, safer code and a stronger, more confident team.
